Definition: of Hebrew origin (H3130); Joseph, the name of seven Israelites:--Joseph.
BiblicalUsage: Joseph is the name of the patriarch, the husband of Mary, and the rich man of Arimathea, and the New Testament holds them apart by their deeds. In Matthew 1:20 the angel tells Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife, in Matthew 27:59 Joseph of Arimathea takes the body of Jesus and wraps it in clean linen, and in Acts 7:9 the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the three Josephs show three kinds of faithfulness: one believed a dream, one gave his tomb, and one forgave the brothers who sold him.
